sourceComparisons.Comparison: The first frame-matched state moves the travel accumulator from -1 to 0 and sends 50; the rising contact edge sets the platform, whose change sends 50. Before the drive the wire carries exactly 50, 50 and no 400 (no other sender runs: increments need a cache of at least 151, the 400 restore runs only from Delocalize).
A synchronized RobotState with IS_ON_CHARGER (bit 12) calls SetOnCharger, which sets the platform flag on the rising edge.
IsRunnableInternal returns the platform flag (robot+0x34A), so DriveOffCharger is runnable on the contacts.

checks.travelRule: Recomputed from the received RobotStates: sum of |MoveRobotPoseForward(pose,-20 mm) difference| in f32 from the identity pose, frame-matched states only (M4-019 C7). Graded only if the crossing state is the same without the first-state term.

sourceComparisons.Comparison: The travel is the summed XY displacement of MoveRobotPoseForward(pose, -20 mm) over frame-matched states; 400 is sent only once it is strictly greater than 50.0 (ble at 0x00512E96). SetOnCharger(false) leaves the platform set, so the contacts dropping sends nothing.
The platform clears only when the robot's footprint leaves the located charger's; until then no platform change sends 400.
